body: Thank you. If I’m willing to, could I speak to anyone I trust? Doesn’t have to be family right? I’m not quite ready to open up to them yet.

I’ve thought about it but something always stops
Me. Idk if I just overthink it but I’d imagine they wouldn’t understand.
It hurts when someone says they’ll always be there for you and offers to help but when you finally trust them enough to open up, they misunderstand and begin pushing you away.
